description: This source file defines the ConnectionManager class in Kotlin, responsible for managing network connections, TLS parameters, and device capabilities for an Android application related to 'OpenClaw'. It includes methods for building connection options, resolving TLS parameters, and generating user agent and client info.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connection parameters, TLS configurations, and device capabilities for the Android app, providing methods to generate connection options, user agent strings, and resolve TLS info based on endpoint data and stored preferences.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a given endpoint based on stored fingerprint, endpoint hints, and manual TLS settings.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Generates a set of runtime flags capturing device capabilities and app build info.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of advertised invoke commands based on runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of advertised capabilities based on runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Provides the app version name, appending '-dev' in debug builds if not already present.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the device model identifier string.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs a user agent string for the device, including app version and Android SDK info.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Builds client information encapsulating device and app info for connection registration.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options for a 'node' role client.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options for an 'operator' role client.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a specific endpoint using preferences and endpoint data.
